description: Move a project checkout to a new folder with everything attached to it: worktrees, the Anima workspace and its sessions, transcripts, auto memory, Claude Code settings, task scripts, scheduler actions, and a heads-up to open sessions.

move.description: Move --from <abs> to --to <abs>: worktrees go to <to>.worktrees/<branch>, broken leftovers to the Trash, the workspace follows (optionally renamed with --name), old-path mentions are rewritten where they are live config and reported elsewhere, open sessions are notified. --dry-run prints the plan and changes nothing. Refuses while a session in the folders is mid-turn.

args.name: --from
args.description: Absolute path of the checkout to move

args.name: --to
args.description: Absolute path it moves to (must not exist; its parent must)

args.name: --name
args.description: New name for the Anima workspace
